description.value: Healthy Habits is a health food store on 3rd Avenue in Port Alberni offering a broad range of natural and specialty food products. The store describes itself as carrying 'a bit of everything' with a 'full range of foods,' and is an active local retailer with curbside and in-store pickup available. It is one of the few dedicated health food options for cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page confirms the business is real and active, with posts as recent as 2 days before fetch and April 30. Address and phone on Facebook (2940 3rd Ave, Port Alberni, BC, V9Y-2A7; 250-724-6280) match OSM tags exactly. The intro copy ('We have a bit of everything...Full range of foods') confirms a health food store with groceries; no cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the available content.
concerns: Only a Facebook page is available as the website; no dedicated business website found.
